name: Kousoku Arcueil no Kyouen
original_name: 拘束 アルクイユの狂宴
source:
Hero takes a part-time job at an island hotel. There are few customers here and only two staff members including manager and protagonist. The hotel and its customers have mysteries to uncover.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一座岛上的旅馆找到兼职。这里客人很少，工作人员连经理和主角在内也只有两人。这家旅馆及其客人身上，都隐藏着等待揭开的谜团。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
